vocabulary.example: I forgot the tickets. Mea culpa.

vocabulary.meaning_en: said after a small accident, like dropping something
(informal) my mistake; it's a small thing
vocabulary.example: The capital is Ottawa, not Toronto? My bad.

vocabulary.meaning_en: something that is not polite to do in public
vocabulary.example: Talking loudly on the phone in a mosque is a social no-no.

vocabulary.meaning_en: used to ask for forgiveness, to pass someone, or to ask them to repeat
vocabulary.example: Pardon me, can I get past?

vocabulary.meaning_en: to say you are sorry for something serious
vocabulary.example: I want to apologize for what I did.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to stop being angry with someone for something bad they did
a little rude, but often in a funny way
to do something to repair a relationship after you hurt someone
vocabulary.example: He wants to make amends with his brother.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to hurt someone's feelings or make them upset
vocabulary.example: I didn't mean to offend you.

vocabulary.meaning_en: words of sympathy when someone has died
a polite word for someone's death
vocabulary.example: I'm sorry to hear about your grandfather's passing.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the death of someone you love
vocabulary.example: I'm so sorry for your loss.

vocabulary.meaning_en: great sadness, especially after a death
vocabulary.example: In times of grief, kind words help.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to say that you did it and it was your fault
vocabulary.example: A good leader takes responsibility for mistakes.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a reason you give to explain a mistake
vocabulary.example: Never ruin an apology with an excuse.

fine_lines.title: light mistakes: whoops / my bad / sorry about that
fine_lines.explanation_ar: whoops عند حادث بسيط (سقوط شيء). my bad عند خطأ صغير في معلومة. sorry about that عندما تقاطع شخصًا بدون قصد.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Whoops: a small accident (dropping something). My bad: a small mistake in information. Sorry about that: you interrupted or did a small thing wrong.

examples.sentence: My bad, the meeting is at three, not two.
Sorry about that; please go on.

fine_lines.title: I didn't mean to offend vs I don't want to offend
words: I didn't mean to offend you
I don't want to offend you
fine_lines.explanation_ar: I didn't mean to offend you (بالماضي) اعتذار صادق بعد أن جرحت شخصًا دون قصد. أما I don't want to offend you قبل الكلام فغالبًا تعني أن المتكلم سيقول شيئًا جارحًا!
fine_lines.explanation_en: "I didn't mean to offend you" (past) is a real apology after you hurt someone by accident. "I don't want to offend you, but..." before speaking often means the person is about to say something hurtful!

examples.word: I didn't mean to offend you
examples.sentence: I didn't mean to offend you. I'm sorry.

examples.word: I don't want to offend you
examples.sentence: I don't want to offend you, but your plan is terrible.

fine_lines.title: Excuse me? / Pardon me? (tone)
fine_lines.explanation_ar: بنبرة لطيفة تعنيان: لم أسمعك، أعد من فضلك. وبنبرة غاضبة تعنيان: لم يعجبني ما قلت!
fine_lines.explanation_en: With a soft tone they mean "I didn't hear you, please repeat". With an angry tone they mean "I don't like what you said!"

examples.sentence: Excuse me? What did you say? It's noisy here.
Pardon me? You think I'm lazy?

expressions.phrase: Please excuse me, I have to leave.
expressions.example: Please excuse me, I have another appointment.

expressions.phrase: Excuse me, that's not quite right.
expressions.example: Excuse me, that's not quite right. Ottawa is the capital.
Pardon me, I missed that. Could you repeat it?

expressions.meaning_en: a strong apology for a serious mistake
expressions.example: I want to apologize for my behaviour yesterday.

expressions.meaning_en: asking for forgiveness after a serious mistake
expressions.example: I'm two hours late. Please forgive me.

expressions.meaning_en: I want to repair our relationship.
expressions.example: I lied to you, and I want to make amends.
I heard about your father. My condolences.

expressions.phrase: I'm sorry to hear about ...'s passing.
expressions.example: I'm sorry to hear about your uncle's passing.

expressions.phrase: I'm so sorry for your loss.
expressions.meaning_en: sympathy for someone whose loved one died
expressions.example: I'm so sorry for your loss.
You broke his car. Sorry won't cut it.

grammar.title: Three parts of a real apology
grammar.explanation_ar: 1) اعتذر (I apologize / Please forgive me). 2) تحمّل المسؤولية (It was my fault). 3) أصلح الأمر (How can I make amends?). ولا تُفسد الاعتذار بعذر: I'm sorry, but... ليست اعتذارًا حقيقيًا.
grammar.explanation_en: 1) Apologize. 2) Take responsibility. 3) Make amends (ask how to fix it). Don't ruin it with an excuse: "I'm sorry, but..." is not a real apology.
examples: I apologize. It was my mistake.
How can I make it right?
Never ruin an apology with an excuse.
